anchor_rank_data: Macro correctness on the 500-label training candidate bank only.
diagnosis_scope: Disjoint from this fit, previously summarized for the xRoute training profile-budget diagnostic.
cost_predictor: OLS of shared input count on raw prompt characters, clipped to at least one, plus per-model/task mean output count. Probe estimates only.
realized_cost_proxy: Released input and output token counts times their released per-million model rates, divided by one million. No invoice data.
utility: Correctness probability minus lambda times estimated cost in hundreds of proxy micro-units.
policy_endpoints: Global 0=incumbent and 1=newcomer; domain integer task bit mask; query families use global endpoints followed by lambda order.
calibration: First/second 50 probes, each 10 per task. Choose minimum-cost mixture at the incumbent's support macro minus .005. Refit rules on all 100.
reference_groups: Use the 160 established reference texts without labels for scalar ability calibration.
scalar_control: For each fitted model solve the scalar ability that recovers the 8D profile's equal-task reference mean under the same shared difficulty. Recompute for each half and full support fit.
comparison: Controls include all global and per-task assignments, task-mean quality with query length and price, and reference-matched scalar ability. Select the strongest by lowest support estimate at the floor.
deployment_information: The benchmark task label is known at routing time for all cost estimators and domain-based controls.
cost_match: Pick best support quality within embedding support-estimated cost. If no control can meet cost, flag and use its cheapest achievable policy.
broader_reference: Cheapest support-fit fixed model among all 15 meeting the incumbent floor. Reports wider eligibility outside the paired gate.
mixture: One independently sampled endpoint and one chosen model per arriving prompt. Score exact expectation.
estimand: Primary bill and quality means weight the five tasks equally and give equal weight to all 14 arrivals and 3 seeds. Observed task frequencies are descriptive.

inputs: Prepared xRouteBench training vectors and group positions
reproduction.runtime: Use the project's Python environment with pyarrow and scipy.

result.scope: Official xRouteBench training, conditional on models, seeds and fitted policies.
result.amortization: Point forecasts use actual released newcomer tokens on 100 probes, positive incumbent bill savings, and the per-arrival observed quality floor. Matched-evidence controls share probe costs.

break_even_check.baseline: Always use the incumbent without purchasing newcomer probes.
